headline: French judges open war-crimes investigation into Israeli strike on Beirut residential building (Nov 2024) that killed
dek: France's crimes-against-humanity unit at the Paris Judicial Court has appointed two investigating judges into a war-crimes complaint over an Israeli strike on a 12-storey residential building in central Beirut on 2024-11-26, hours before the then ceasefire), which killed seven civilians including…
sources: Cherri's lawyer Clemence Bectarte, speaking to AFP; complaint filed with the International Federation for Human Rights

sections.what_happened: France's crimes-against-humanity unit at the Paris Judicial Court has appointed two investigating judges into a war-crimes complaint over an Israeli strike on a 12-storey residential building in central Beirut on 2024-11-26, hours before the then ceasefire), which killed seven civilians including Cherri's parents aged 87 and 77 and destroyed three floors. Bectarte called it 'a first'. The complaint cites Amnesty International / Forensic Architecture research. Separate PNAT/flotilla and Gaza-children investigations also pending.
sections.what_verified: Single declared-tier family (AFP via Dawn). Sig 2, below the >=3 two-family PASS gate; reported with attribution.
sections.what_disputed: No Israeli response carried in the report. The strike itself (Nov 2024) is historical; the new fact is the judicial appointment, not a new strike. Other pending cases show this is one track among several, not a verdict.
sections.context: Background: French judges open war-crimes investigation into Israeli strike on Beirut residential building (Nov 2024) that killed French-Lebanese artist Ali Cherri's parents
